# Comics and webtoons

**Four-panel strips and vertical webtoon episodes with one consistent character: script, panels, lettering, export.**

Makes short comic strips and vertical-scroll webtoon episodes starring a consistent AI character — panel scripts (four-panel setup / development / turn / payoff and scroll-paced episodes), a character sheet plus style-anchor workflow that keeps one face, outfit and drawing style across every panel, text-free panel prompts, lettering with tested HTML templates (speech, caption, agent and whisper balloons, SFX), and exports to 1080×1350 strips or 800×1280 webtoon slices. Use when someone wants a comic, comic strip, four-panel gag, webtoon or manga-style episode, a carousel comic, or wants to tell a character's story in panels.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 2–3 h per strip · 1–2 days per episode | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Pick the format first
2. Write the panel script
3. Make the character sheet
4. Lock the style with panel 1
5. Generate the rest without text
6. Letter it with real fonts
7. Export the episode in slices
8. Publish with labels and approval

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/comics-and-webtoons.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/comics-and-webtoons.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/comics-and-webtoons.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/comics-and-webtoons.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill comics-and-webtoons`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `comics-and-webtoons.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/comics-and-webtoons`.
